title: Better Together: Quantifying the Benefits of AI-Assisted Recruitment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the average age of applicants who rank higher in the AI screening process versus the traditional resume screening process, and analyzing rates of skill misreporting across different age groups.

Evaluating the years of professional experience of candidates who benefit from the AI interview compared to the traditional pipeline, and tracking skill exaggeration across different experience levels.

Comparing the highest educational attainment (e.g., Bachelor's or Master's degrees) of candidates who benefit from the AI assessment versus those who are ranked lower by it compared to human screening.
Analyzing differential drop-out rates between men and women invited to the AI interview phase, and evaluating gender differences in skill misreporting and overall AI favorability.
Regressing the likelihood of a candidate misreporting their skills on the purchasing power parity (PPP)-adjusted GDP per capita of their country of residence.
